extraction.name: RoboFAC Dataset
extraction.description: A large-scale and diverse robotic failure dataset comprising 9,440 erroneous manipulation trajectories and 78,623 QA pairs across 16 diverse tasks and 53 scenes in both simulation and real-world environments. The dataset is designed to evaluate and improve robotic failure analysis and correction capabilities, covering six failure taxonomies organized across three hierarchical levels (Task Planning Error, Motion Planning Error, Execution Control Error). It includes multi-dimensional annotations with eight question types for comprehensive failure understanding and correction.
extraction.creator: Weifeng Lu, Minghao Ye, Zewei Ye, Ruihan Tao, Shuo Yang, Bo Zhao
extraction.publisher: School of AI, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Xiamen University; Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen
extraction.citeAs: RoboFAC: A Comprehensive Framework for Robotic Failure Analysis and Correction
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed through a combination of simulation and real-world data collection. Simulation data was collected using 14 robotic tasks in the ManiSkill environment, augmented with objects from the YCB Object Dataset and scenes from ReplicaCAD and AI2-THOR. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using the SO-100 robotic arm for 6 tasks, including two not present in simulation. Data collection involved recording robotic failure videos along with descriptive text, including substage information, failure taxonomy, and detailed error explanations. Manual data cleaning was performed to retain approximately 75% of the collected simulation data due to motion planning failures.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Experiments, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Simulation data was collected using ManiSkill environment with YCB Object Dataset objects and ReplicaCAD/AI2-THOR scenes. Real-world data was collected via teleoperation using SO-100 robotic arm. Raw data included robotic failure videos with associated textual descriptions containing substage information, failure taxonomy, and error explanations.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data cleaning was performed to remove trajectories that did not align with textual descriptions. Approximately 75% of collected simulation data was retained after manual cleaning. The dataset includes both failure trajectories (8,960 simulated, 480 real-world) and successful trajectories (1,160 simulated, 122 real-world) to prevent overfitting to failure patterns.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Raw data was annotated to construct video-based QA samples corresponding to eight question types covering Task Understanding, Failure Analysis, and Failure Correction. For five question types (task identification, task planning, failure detection, failure identification, failure locating), reference answers were directly extracted from textual descriptions. For the remaining three types (failure explanation, high-level correction, low-level correction), GPT-4o was used to generate reference answers based on video and textual descriptions, followed by manual review and correction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: GPT-4o for automated annotation generation with manual review and correction
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: GPT-4o outputs were manually reviewed and corrected to ensure annotation quality. The annotation process involved using both video and textual descriptions to generate comprehensive answers for failure explanation, high-level correction, and low-level correction question types.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset and model are publicly available at https://github.com/MINT-SJTU/RoboFAC with versioning information implied through the repository structure and release notes.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset addresses limitations in Vision-Language-Action models that struggle with failure recovery in open-world scenarios, potentially improving robotic safety and reliability in real-world applications. The framework enables better failure analysis and correction capabilities that could enhance robotic manipulation performance.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may inherit biases from the ManiSkill simulation environment, YCB Object Dataset, ReplicaCAD, and AI2-THOR scenes used for simulation data collection. Real-world data collection via teleoperation may introduce biases related to operator preferences and specific robotic arm configurations.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset focuses on robotic manipulation failures and may not generalize to other types of robotic failures or domains. The integration of the correction model into VLA control pipelines is not yet seamless, and the system requires predefined timestamps for correction intervention. The dataset includes only 6 real-world tasks with limited scene diversity compared to simulation environments.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for robotic failure analysis and correction models. The dataset is designed for developing models capable of Task Understanding, Failure Analysis, and Failure Correction in robotic manipulation scenarios, with applications in improving VLA model robustness and real-world deployment.
